title: A Circular Chatterjee's Correlation Coefficient
summary: Chatterjee's rank correlation is a directed measure of association designed to detect whether one variable can be predicted as a function of another. While the original coefficient is naturally defined for real-valued data, circular data poses additional difficulty. Applying the usual construction requires cutting each circle at an arbitrary point and treating it as a line. Different choices of cut points can lead to different finite-sample values, even though the underlying circular relationship is unchanged.
